Hi Natalie,

Per our MAP review yesterday I wanted to put the final gating checklist and e-sign runway in writing so procurement and legal have a single playbook. I've attached the MAP_v3 and the SOW draft (short stub). Key milestones I recommend: 

- Acceptance gating (what Storify signs off on): performance baseline tests (3-day MAP eval), security attestation (SOC2 evidence), and data residency confirmation. Owner: Storify Procurement / Tech POC.
- Legal redlines complete: target Jul 23. Owner: Storify Legal + Redwood Legal.
- eSign routing: two-step envelope (PO + Legal countersign). Proposed signature window: Aug 2 - Aug 4 (we can compress if you need).
- Start date (Day 0): target Aug 9 (this is the first production-ready calendar day).

Asks: can you confirm by Jul 20 whether the signature window above is acceptable? If procurement needs a buffer, flag the date and we'll propose alternatives. I also highlighted billing trigger (start date vs signature date) in the SOW draft — we generally bill on Day 0 but can carve a billing milestone if necessary.

Attachments: MAP_v3.xlsx (MAP checklist), SOW_draft_v2.pdf (billing & SOW line items).

If it helps, I can send a short DocuSign template and routing plan to your contracts inbox so your legal team can review the envelope in advance.

Best,
